components.name: Hobbywing XRotor X15 Motor+ESC+Prop Combo CW (18S)

warnings: Requires 18S battery system — incompatible with 12S/14S builds.
Custom frame required for 135mm motor mounts.
Each unit ~5.9kg — 6 motors = 35.4kg motors alone.

components.notes: X15 is for 50kg+ MTOW quad builds. 72kg/axis max. Requires custom 18S power system.

editorial.why_it_fits: Only motor capable of safe 50kg MTOW on a quad with 2:1 thrust margin.
editorial.the_catch: ₹1L+/unit. Requires 18S custom battery. Motor weight alone is prohibitive for hex.
editorial.savings_note: For 50kg MTOW quad: 4 units = ₹4L+. Full build cost ₹10L+.
editorial.best_for: Industrial 40–50kg MTOW quadcopter cargo/spray builds only.

components.name: GenX 22000mAh 12S 25C LiPo Battery

warnings: Standard LiPo chemistry — fire risk. Use LiPo safe bag at all times.
200 cycle life — plan replacement budget.
25C is a peak/paper spec; sustained hover draw should not exceed 10C (220A).

components.notes: Budget entry battery. Suitable for 20–25kg MTOW builds. 15 min estimated flight at 20kg MTOW.

components.name: GenX 22000mAh 14S 15C Semi-Solid LiPo Battery

warnings: Requires 14S compatible charger — skyrc_pc1260 only supports 12S.
Semi-solid safer than LiPo but still needs safe bag.

components.notes: 14S pack for X9/X11 motor builds. Better energy density than 12S equivalent. ~18 min at 30kg MTOW.

components.name: Tattu 35000mAh 14S1P Smart LiPo Battery

warnings: Import only — 30 day lead time.
Smart BMS provides per-cell monitoring via CAN.

components.notes: 35Ah 14S — highest capacity practical single pack. ~25 min at 40kg MTOW. Smart BMS for health monitoring.

components.name: UltraPower UP2800-14S Dual Channel 14S Battery Charger

warnings: skyrc_pc1260 is 12S ONLY — do not use for 14S batteries.

components.notes: Required charger for 14S builds. PC1260 does not support 14S — always use this for 14S battery sets.

components.name: Multistar High Capacity 16000mAh 6S 10C LiPo Battery

warnings: 6S ONLY — for survey/hobby builds under 8kg AUW.
NOT compatible with 12S or 14S agricultural drone builds.
10C rating is low — monitor cell sag during flight.

components.notes: Entry-level survey battery. 6S only. Not for spray drones.

components.name: Holybro Pixhawk 6X Flight Controller (Standard Set)
components.notes: FMUv6X standard. Superior to Pixhawk 6C with H753 processor and triple IMU. CAN for DroneCAN ESCs.

editorial.why_it_fits: Top-tier open standard FC. Best for CAN-equipped motor builds.
editorial.the_catch: No ADS-B built-in unlike Cube Orange+.
editorial.savings_note: ₹36,000 vs ₹50,000 Cube Orange+. ~30% cheaper with similar performance.
editorial.best_for: Premium agricultural builds needing ArduPilot reliability and CAN support.

components.name: JIYI K++ V2 Agricultural Flight Controller

warnings: Closed ecosystem — no ArduPilot/PX4. Use only JIYI app and accessories.
Spray system control requires JIYI spray module add-on.

components.notes: Agriculture-specific FC with terrain following and spray integration. Widely used in China agri-drones.

editorial.why_it_fits: Native agriculture workflow: terrain follow, AB-line spray, flow meter integration.
editorial.the_catch: Proprietary system — vendor lock-in. No open-source tuning.
editorial.savings_note: ₹52,000 — justified for production agri builds.
editorial.best_for: Full autonomous spray operations with JIYI ecosystem.

components.name: Radiomaster TX16S Mark II Multi-Protocol RC Transmitter

warnings: Default 2.4GHz range ~2km. Upgrade to ELRS 900MHz module for 10km+.

components.notes: Open-source EdgeTX radio. Most versatile option for ArduPilot builds. Upgrade to 900MHz ELRS for agri range.

editorial.why_it_fits: Open protocol, EdgeTX firmware, companion to ArduPilot builds.
editorial.the_catch: 2.4GHz base unit — needs ELRS 900MHz module (₹6,000 extra) for 10km range.
editorial.savings_note: ₹22,000 + ₹6,000 ELRS = ₹28,000 total. Cheaper than Skydroid H12.
editorial.best_for: Pixhawk-based custom builds needing versatile RC control.

components.name: FrSky Taranis X9D Plus Special Edition Transmitter

warnings: 2.4GHz base — pair with R9M 900MHz module for 8km+ range.

components.notes: Industry-standard open-source radio. OpenTX/EdgeTX compatible. R9M module adds 900MHz long range.

components.name: Holybro M9N GNSS Multi-Constellation GPS Module

warnings: Mount on mast 15cm+ away from ESCs and power cables to prevent compass interference.

components.notes: 25Hz update rate, 1.5m accuracy. Good mid-range choice for spray/mapping builds.

editorial.why_it_fits: 25Hz update, all 4 constellations, IST8310 compass. Upgrade from HGLRC M100.
editorial.the_catch: Not RTK — 1.5m accuracy. For centimetre-level, use Here4 RTK.
editorial.savings_note: ₹8,500 vs ₹36,538 Here4 RTK. 77% cheaper with adequate accuracy for spray.
editorial.best_for: Standard spray missions where 1–2m accuracy is sufficient.

components.name: CubePilot Here3+ Multi-Band RTK GPS + iStand

specs.constellations: GPS L1/L2 + GLONASS G1/G2 + Galileo E1/E5 + BeiDou

warnings: RTK base station required for cm-level accuracy. Only DroneCAN — no UART mode.
Requires RTCM3 base station stream for RTK fix.

components.notes: CubePilot's dual-band RTK GPS. 1cm accuracy with base station. DroneCAN only.

components.name: Benewake TFmini-S Short-Range LiDAR Distance Sensor
components.notes: Ultra-light 5g LiDAR for altitude hold and terrain following up to 12m. Budget-tier for spray altitude consistency.

components.name: Benewake TF03 100m Industrial LiDAR Altitude Sensor
components.notes: IP67, 100m range, industrial-grade. For terrain-following agricultural spray and precision altitude hold.

components.name: Ainstein US-D1 77GHz Radar Altimeter
components.notes: mmWave radar — immune to dust, spray droplets, and fog unlike optical LiDAR. Best for crop canopy terrain following.

editorial.why_it_fits: Works through spray mist and dust unlike LiDAR. 45m range, 13° FOV for canopy following.
editorial.the_catch: ₹68,000 — premium cost. Import only.
editorial.savings_note: Worth it for commercial spray ops where LiDAR fails in heavy spray conditions.
editorial.best_for: Commercial spray operators needing reliable terrain following in dense spray environments.

components.name: Hobbywing XRotor 8L Brushless Agricultural Pump

warnings: Higher flow rate than 5L pump — use 6-8 nozzles for even coverage.

components.notes: 8L/min flow. Better for 10–20L tanks needing faster cycle time. Compatible with 12S and 14S builds.

components.name: EFT G-Series 16L Agricultural Spray Tank with Mounting Plate

warnings: 16L of water = 16kg. Verify total MTOW before using. EFT E616P MTOW = 36kg — leaves only 13kg margin for dry weight.
USE RULE R10: Verify frame MTOW allows 16L tank payload.

components.notes: 16L tank. Pairs with EFT E616P frame. NOTE: Frame MTOW check required — may overload at full capacity.

components.name: EFT G620 20L Agricultural Spray Tank (Baffled HDPE)

warnings: 20L water = 20kg liquid payload. EFT G620 MTOW = 51.2kg. Dry weight must stay below 31.2kg.

components.notes: 20L baffled tank for EFT G620. Anti-slosh design critical for stable flight with full tank.

components.name: Generic 7L HDPE Drone Spray Tank (Custom Fabricated)

warnings: No baffles — significant COG shift during partially filled flight.
Custom fabricated — no warranty or fit guarantee for specific frames.

components.notes: Budget 7L tank for light spray trials. No baffles = COG shift risk at partial fill. For trial/testing only.

components.name: Sony A7R V 61MP Full-Frame Camera (RGB Mapping Payload)

warnings: Requires gimbal (add ₹40,000 for T1 gimbal).
Camera trigger integration via hotshoe or IR cable.
RGB only — no spectral analysis.

components.notes: Highest resolution RGB mapping camera. GSD 1.2cm/px at 100m AGL. Photogrammetry use only.

components.name: RunCam Split 4 4K Action Camera (Budget Survey)

warnings: Rolling shutter — causes jello effect. Use ND filters at speed.
18cm GSD at 100m — only for broad coverage, not precision mapping.

components.notes: Ultra-light budget camera for broad area FPV and rough mapping. Not for precision photogrammetry.

components.name: Hobbymate H6AC 80W 6S Balance Charger

warnings: 6S MAXIMUM. DO NOT USE on 12S or 14S batteries — fire risk.
Only for survey/hobby 6S builds.

components.notes: Budget 6S charger for survey drones only.

components.name: FrSky R9 Slim+ 900MHz Long Range Receiver

warnings: Requires R9M 900MHz module on transmitter.
Not compatible with 2.4GHz transmitters.

components.notes: 900MHz long-range receiver. 8km range with R9M TX module. Budget long-range option.

components.name: BetaFPV ELRS Lite 2.4GHz Receiver

warnings: 2.4GHz 2km range only — upgrade to 900MHz ELRS receiver for agriculture (10km+).

components.notes: Ultra-cheap receiver for 2.4GHz builds. Insufficient range for agriculture — upgrade to 900MHz for field use.

components.name: Holybro 10A Dual 5V/12V BEC (Power Regulator)
components.notes: Dual-output BEC for 12S/14S systems. Provides 5V for FC and 12V for accessories (lights, pump relay).

components.name: Matek FCHUB-12S High-Voltage PDB with BEC

compatibility.note: Built-in current sensing — no external MAUCH sensor needed

components.notes: Compact PDB with integrated 5V BEC and current sensing. Replaces need for separate MAUCH sensor.

hard_rules.result: No power telemetry, possible FC damage
Frame fatigue, warranty void, crash risk

warning_rules.result: Poor climb performance, no wind margin
